title: Counterpoint: US smartphone market contracts, budget devices hit hardest
description: Counterpoint Research’s latest report examines smartphone sales in the US for the April 1 – June 30 period, aka Q2. The overall market fell by 5% compared to last year as the ongoing memory chip crisis resulted in increased average asking prices (ASP) for devices across the board. In addition, rising gas prices due to the ongoing conflicts in the Middle East also affected consumer purchasing power. Apple, Samsung, Motorola and Google saw their combined sales drop by 4% on a year-over-year basis. The remaining brands doing business in the US saw their sales decline by up to 45% compared to...

title: Apple again reported to skip launching the iPhone 18 this year
description: Apple has long been rumored to launch the iPhone 18 series and the iPhone Ultra in phases, with multiple reports claiming the iPhone 18 won't launch this year. Now, a new media report, citing Apple supplier Pegatron, again states that the iPhone 18 won't launch this year and will arrive in 2027 instead. During the earnings call for Q2 2026, Pegatron confirmed that the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max will be launched next month, but the iPhone 18 is expected to launch in Q1 2027, meaning anytime between January and March 2027. Previous reports claimed the iPhone 18 would arrive in March...

title: Google promises 7 years of spare parts availability for the Pixel 11 lineup
description: Google officially unveiled the Pixel 11 series at its Made by Google event. Google has now shared details about the availability of spare parts for the new smartphones. At the Pixel 11 series launch event in India, Google reportedly confirmed that it will provide 7 years of spare parts support for the new smartphones. Google says spares will be available in every market where the Pixel 11 series is sold, making it easier for users to replace components such as the battery or display even years after buying the phone. One of the first components to degrade over time is the...

title: iPhone 20 Pro and 20 Pro Max's bezel-less displays detailed in new leak
description: There have been conflicting reports surrounding Apple’s twentieth-anniversary iPhone, aka the iPhone 20 Pro, lately. Earlier this week, the all-glass device was said to be canceled due to alleged low yield rates but a second report from Bloomberg quickly refuted those claims and said that the device is still on track to launch next year. Tipster Digital Chat Station is now chiming in with details surrounding the iPhone 20 Pro and 20 Pro Max. He claims that the two devices known internally as the V73 and V74 feature a larger screen than the current crop of iPhone Pro models but with the...

title: Xiaomi unveils HyperOS 4 with a new glass look, UI customizations and more AI
description: Xiaomi’s HyperOS releases aren’t tied to Android releases – the company is rolling out the Android 17 update as HyperOS 3 and now it has unveiled HyperOS 4, which will most likely be based on the same core. It features a heavily reworked user interface, though. Do you like the new glass UI trend? Well, too bad – it’s the new design language for HyperOS 4. The system will even put effort into rendering realistic-looking refraction. A new glass look for HyperOS 4 The redesigned UI will offer more customization options for the lock screen, letting you arrange the clock and...

title: Tecno Pova 8 Pro unveiled with an Alive Matrix Display, P1 Graphic Chip, and 144FPS gaming support
description: The Tecno Pova 8 Pro that we've been hearing about for the past few months is now official. The Tecno Pova 8 Pro is powered by the Dimensity 7400 Ultimate SoC and comes with up to 12GB of RAM and 512GB of storage onboard. The smartphone also has a P1 Graphic Chip under the hood to enhance the gaming experience and enable 144FPS gaming through game frame interpolation. Tecno says the Pova 8 Pro supports 90FPS gameplay in RPG games and 144FPS gameplay in FPS and MOBA games. On the software side, you get HiOS 16, based on Android 16, and Tecno has promised two Android OS upgrades and...

title: Apple wants to pay publishers to use their content in Siri AI
description: According to a new report, Apple wants to make content deals with online publishers, possibly worth up to nine figures, for the new Siri AI to be able to use their stuff so it can answer questions about current events and information. Apple has allegedly proposed a variable compensation plan. Payments would only be made to the publishers it partners with if their content is used in Siri AI. Apple wants to be proactive here and play the good guy so that it can avoid being sued by publishers for using their content for AI services. This isn't just a theoretical possibility, either....

title: Honor Magic9 Pro to have two 200MP cameras, new rumor claims
description: During the unveiling of the Robot Phone, Honor also teased the upcoming Magic9 series, which is going to be unveiled in September. The company's teaser image revealed that one of the devices will have a 200MP camera using a 1/1.4" type sensor with OIS. This is the same size as the Magic8 Pro's periscope telephoto camera. Now, Digital Chat Station on Weibo brings us some more details. According to him, the Magic9 Pro will have two 200MP cameras - that periscope telephoto with f/2.6 aperture, but also the main camera. Honor Magic8 Pro This will allegedly be using a 1/1.28" type...

title: This is when Google is launching its screen-less Fitbit Air in India
description: Google unveiled the Fitbit Air in early May. It's a screen-less fitness tracker, a form factor that's all the rage these days, after having been popularized by Whoop. The Fitbit Air's availability has been spotty even in markets where it is officially available, but there are also plenty of countries where it hasn't even launched yet. India is one of them. However, Google has now finally unveiled when the Fitbit Air will land in India: in October. The screenshot you can see above is from the Indian launch of the Pixel 11 family that we attended, which is when the company decided...

title: Sony says that Xperia 1 VIII sales are strong, calls the microSD slot and 3.5mm jack "integral"
description: Japanese publication ITmedia Mobile interviewed Sony’s Shohachi Ike and Eri Kitazawa, who brought some encouraging news about the performance of the Xperia 1 VIII. You may have thought that Sony had given up on the smartphone market, but it hasn’t – in fact, the Mark 8 is enjoying strong sales. Even better, Sony is listening to its customers. The Sony Xperia 1 VIII is more expensive than its predecessor – in Japan, the phone crossed the JPY 200,000 mark. That said, the European prices remained the same – €1,500 / £1,400 for the base 12/256GB model, the same as the Mark 7 prices (which, to...

title: iPhone 18 may get a significant bump in RAM after all
description: A new research note from analyst Jeff Pu today says the iPhone 18 will get 12GB of RAM after all, a significant bump up from the 8GB of RAM that the iPhone 17 has. It will also allegedly get the new Dynamic Island design that will make its debut on the upcoming iPhone 18 Pro. Recently, another analyst, Ming-Chi Kuo, said that the iPhone 18, like the iPhone 18e, would only have 9GB of RAM, but Pu says it's actually only the iPhone 18e that's getting 9GB. Both the iPhone 18 and the iPhone 18e are expected to be powered by the A20 chip. iPhone 17 And they could be launching at the...

title: Samsung's Galaxy S27 series reportedly won't copy this upcoming iPhone feature
description: Back in May we heard that the upcoming Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra could get a 200MP main camera with variable aperture. Such a move would undoubtedly have been influenced by all the rumors claiming Apple's iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max would have a variable aperture main camera. Today, a new report from Korea says Samsung has ultimately decided against using a variable aperture main camera on any device in the Galaxy S27 series. Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra The reasoning apparently has to do with increased manufacturing costs and the fact that the variable aperture would make the...

title: Honor teases Magic9 series, confirms September launch
description: Near the end of today’s Robot Phone keynote, Honor pulled out a teaser for the upcoming Magic9 series. The brand confirmed that the Magic9 series is due to launch in September, which is a month earlier than last year’s Magic8 series. The teaser gives a glimpse into the Magic9 or Magic9 Pro’s camera module, which appears to be off-center in the corner. A few other things also stand out. The ring around the sensors features a knurling pattern, which looks like the one on the Xiaomi 17 Ultra Leica Edition. It remains to be seen if the one on the Magic9 series will rotate and feature...

title: Google Pixel Buds Pro 2 get a new color and new software features
description: Earlier today, Google announced the Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL, Pixel 11 Pro Fold, Pixel Watch 5, and Pixel Tag. The company hasn't also unveiled a new pair of Pixel Buds, but it has added a new color for the Pixel Buds Pro 2 - Olive. This is now available to order from the Google Store, and like all the other colors, the Pixel Buds Pro 2 can currently be had for $189, down from the RRP of $229. The price cut ends on August 23. Aside from the new hue, the Olive Pixel Buds Pro 2 are identical to all the other Pixel Buds Pro 2. However, Google is introducing new software...

title: Google launches Tap to Share for Pixels and Samsung's latest devices
description: For a while now, Google has been rumored to be working on an Android equivalent of Apple's NameDrop. Today, this has become official as Tap to Share. It is available on Pixels from the Pixel 6 onwards, and Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold8, Fold8 Ultra, and Flip8. Google promises to expand support for the feature to more devices "by the end of the year". As you'd expect from the name, this works by tapping two supported devices together. When that happens, stuff is shared - contact info, photos, videos, "and more". It's really that simple. To swap contact info with someone,...

title: Realme P4s Lite gets certified on its way to launch
description: Realme is working on yet another smartphone to add to its already pretty expansive P4 family, the P4s Lite. The device is on its way to India, as it has just been certified for sale in the country by the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS), with the model number RMX5398. This is a necessary pre-launch step for any smartphone that will be sold in India. The certification process hasn't revealed any of the phone's specs, unfortunately. However, a past leak did claim the device would have 4GB of RAM and 64/128GB of storage. It will allegedly be available in Moonlight Silver and Nebula...

title: Motorola Signature is now receiving its Android 17 update
description: Motorola has now started rolling out the update to Android 17 for the Signature, a smartphone that it launched in January. The update is a 5.75GB download, so make sure you grab it over a good enough connection. Once you've installed it, your Signature will be on software version A171WVH.21-16-1-3-4, which has to be the most convoluted naming scheme for smartphone software builds we’ve ever seen, and that's really saying something. Anyway, the changelog says you can expect "a fresh, expressive design", reduced clutter with smarter notifications, faster multitasking with more apps...

title: Poco F9 Pro and F9 Ultra battery details leak
description: Poco is expected to launch the successors to the F8 Pro and F8 Ultra in the coming weeks. While the Poco F9 Pro and Poco F9 Ultra have surfaced on multiple certification websites recently, a new leak has now revealed the battery specs of the two phones. The Poco F9 Pro is expected to be a rebrand of the recently launched Redmi K100 Pro, whereas the F9 Ultra is likely to be a rebadged K100 Pro Max. According to a tipster on X, the Poco F9 Pro could pack a 6,330mAh battery. If accurate, that would mark a significant downgrade from the 8,580mAh battery in the Redmi K100...

title: Samsung Galaxy S26 series receives fifth One UI 9 Beta update
description: Last week, a Samsung representative announced that the fifth One UI 9 Beta update for the Galaxy S26 series would arrive sometime this week. Well, Samsung kept its promise and released the One UI 9 Beta 5 for the Galaxy S26 lineup. It comes almost a month after the fourth beta was rolled out. [#InlinePriceWidget,14320,1#] The One UI 9 Beta 5 for the Galaxy S26 series has firmware version S948BXXU4ZZH6 and requires a download of around 1.1GB. title: New rumor tells us all about Apple's imminent iPhone price hike
description: According to a new rumor from a tipster on X, Apple will be raising prices for all existing iPhone models, as well as those launching next month, by $100. The same source also seems to imply that Apple's launch event for the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and iPhone Ultra will be held on September 8. That is a Tuesday and Apple has in the past held events on Tuesdays, so it's definitely not out of the question. We all know an iPhone price hike is coming.
